policy.morphology: confident lemma is diversity evidence only; exact targetId never changes
policy.smallDeck: omit below minDeck; never pad with weak material

japaneseBoundary.purpose: boundary validation only; no lemma/normalization/identity rewrite

qualityPolicy.contexts: prefer low written-token overlap after source/alignment evidence; legacy duplicate threshold unchanged
qualityPolicy.unknownCuts: deferred from selection; original pool retained
qualityPolicy.canonicalOccurrence: one complete source token per NFKC/casefold target identity; ambiguous occurrences deferred

sourceQuarantine.scope: exact source version/ref/text on either side; originals preserved; no silent spelling correction

limitations: EOF covers provided files, not an unproven full upstream export.
Rank-ordered samples are review aids, not semantic-quality or native-speaker evidence.
Policy publish/publish-thin decisions do not publish assets or admit content to the freeze.
